name: Client call
description: A call with a client or prospect: their needs, what we proposed and the next steps.

sections.heading: Context
sections.guidance: Who the client is, why the call happened and where things stand with them.

sections.heading: Their needs
sections.guidance: Goals, problems and requirements the client described, close to their own words.

sections.heading: What we proposed
sections.guidance: What we showed, offered or proposed, and how the client reacted to each.

sections.heading: Concerns
sections.guidance: Objections, risks and worries the client raised, and any answer given on the call.

sections.heading: Budget and timeline
sections.guidance: Budget, pricing, dates and how the client decides, only as they were stated.

sections.heading: Next steps
sections.guidance: Follow-ups agreed on either side, as Owner: what, by when.
